title: Mapping the network
brief: Before attacking anything, attackers look. Scan the network, read the service banners, and find the host nobody mentioned.
hint.1: scan lists the hosts you can see. Then connect <host> <service> shows what a service says about itself.
hint.2: One banner mentions a host that scan did not list.
hint.3: connect staging ssh. Its banner has the flag.
walkthrough: scan, connect files ftp, connect staging ssh, submit the flag from the banner.
debrief: Recon is reading what systems volunteer: open ports, versions, and careless banners. Scanning is also loud, which is why the trace meter rose. Defenders: hide version details, retire old hosts and alert on scans.
objective.connect: Read a service banner with connect <host> <service>
